stories.headline: Will the Thirlwall report change the debate about Lucy Letby?
stories.description: The inquiry into the former nurse is expected to find failures by her hospital to ensure patient safety.

stories.headline: As Chavez and Maduro images disappear, is Venezuela entering a new chapter?
stories.description: As part of Delcy Rodriguez’s ‘Venezuela reborn’ campaign, murals of leaders like Hugo Chavez are being removed.

stories.headline: Trump: US president doubles down on united Ireland comments on day two of visit
stories.description: The US president was speaking at the Irish Open on Sunday and said "many people agree" with his comments.

stories.headline: Red Sea nations watch as Houthis seize Bab al-Mandeb strait
stories.description: Houthi control of Bab al-Mandeb chokes Suez Canal revenues, triggers refugee flows, and exposes regional security gaps.

stories.headline: Iran-GCC summit: What’s behind the meeting, why is Bahrain not attending?
stories.description: Iran says it plans to hold talks with Iraq and Gulf nations in Oman to help strengthen shared regional security.
